craft_evidence.mills: none ('Italian bi-stretch wool' named as origin only)
craft_evidence.madein: 59 of 80 sampled product pages (74%) state a country: Italy 24, USA 24, India 10, China 1
craft_evidence.heritage: NC — not found on the US site
craft_evidence.process: partial — product copy notes hand-draped bodices and hand-crafted rosettes on some gowns; no account of where
craft_evidence.reasoning: Three in four product pages state where the piece is made — Italy and the USA in equal parts, India for embroidered pieces — but no atelier, workroom, maker or mill is named, and the US site carries no house page to check heritage against. A country on most of the range and little else.
